payload.title: Re-evaluate changed sources and existing vulnerabilities
payload.description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a editor, I want updates to known source items and vulnerabilities to trigger fresh evaluation, so that significant developments are not missed after initial discovery.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Re-evaluate changed sources and existing vulnerabilities
  Scenario: An existing vulnerability changes
    Given a general vulnerability or CVE Monitor already knows a vulnerability
    When its source reports a meaningful advisory, exploitation, remediation or status update
    Then the existing canonical vulnerability/reference lineage retains the revision provenance
    And the changed evidence is eligible for a new relevance and editorial-worthiness evaluation
    And unchanged polls do not manufacture new developments
  Scenario: Worthiness differs from severity
    Given two vulnerability developments have different severity and editorial relevance
    When the publication evaluates them
    Then editorial worthiness is decided using current publication and section context
    And severity is retained as source evidence rather than used as an automatic publication decision
```

Threat Intelligence is one consumer of general monitoring/update behavior. No CVE-only pipeline, severity-only newsworthiness threshold or automatic publishing requirement.
